# flaggr_organization (Resource)

Manages a Flaggr organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "flaggr_organization" "acme" {
  name        = "Acme"
  slug        = "acme"
  description = "Feature flags for every Acme product"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Organization name.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly identifier.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Organization description.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Organization ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = flaggr_organization.acme
  id = "your-organization-id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Organizations are imported by organization ID.
terraform import flaggr_organization.acme "your-organization-id"
```
